This nutrirous soup contains serious portions of lightly-braised meat and many vegetables.|Cooking (Interface)|AoC}} ==Location and Uses== ==={{BotW|-}}=== Creamy Meat Soups are made by [[Cooking]] any [[Meat]], [[Fresh Milk]], [[Rock Salt]], and any [[Vegetable]], herb, or [[Flower]]. Regular Creamy Meat Soups are made by using [[Ingredient]]s without effects or with contradicting effects. However, [[Endura Carrot]]s, [[Swift Carrot]]s, and [[Fortified Pumpkin]]s cannot be used, as they will result in [[Veggie Cream Soup]]. They heal six of [[Link]]'s [[Heart]]s, and they sell for 60 [[Rupee]]s. These Soups are noted to be nutritious, containing a good amount of lightly-braised Meat and Vegetables. Several different variations of Creamy Meat Soup can be made by using different Ingredients. * '''Hearty Creamy Meat Soup''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hearty Creamy Meat Soup}}
Restores your health and temporarily increases your maximum hearts.
This nutritious soup contains serious portions of lightly-braised meat and many vegetables.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Hearty Radish]]es, [[Big Hearty Radish]]es, or other hearty Ingredients. When consumed, they fully heal all of Link's Hearts and grant him [[Extra Hearts]]. They are worth 70 Rupees when sold. * '''Energizing Creamy Meat Soup''':{{Cite|{{Big|Energizing Creamy Meat Soup}}
Instantly refills some of your Stamina Wheel.
This nutritious soup contains serious portions of lightly braised meat and many vegetables.|Inventory|BotW}} Made by adding [[Courser Bee Honey]]. When consumed, they refill a portion of Link's [[Stamina Wheel]]. * '''Hasty Creamy Meat Soup''':{{Cite|{{Big|Hasty Creamy Meat Soup}}
Grants a low-level movement-speed boost.
This nutritious soup contains serious portions of lightly-braised meat and many vegetables.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Swift Violet]]s or other speed-boosting Ingredients. Eating one will temporarily boost Link's movement speed. They heal four of his Hearts and sell for 80 Rupees. * '''Spicy Creamy Meat Soup''':{{Cite|{{Big|Spicy Creamy Meat Soup}}
Grants a low-level cold resistance.
This nutritious soup contains serious portions of lightly-braised meat and many vegetables.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Warm Safflina]]s or other spicy Ingredients. Eating them will grant Link one level of [[Cold Resistance]]. They restore four Hearts to Link, and they sell for 60 Rupees. * '''Electro Creamy Meat Soup''':{{Cite|{{Big|Electro Creamy Meat Soup}}
Grants a low-level electricity resistance.
This nutritious soup contains serious portions of lightly-braised meat and many vegetables.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Electric Safflina]]s or other electricity-related Ingredients. When eaten, Link will gain one level of [[Shock Resistance]] for a short period of time. They heal four of his Hearts, but they can also be sold for 60 Rupees. * '''Mighty Creamy Meat Soup''':{{Cite|{{Big|Mighty Creamy Meat Soup}}
Grants a low-level attack-power boost.
This nutritious soup contains serious portions of lightly-braised meat and many vegetables.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Mighty Thistle]]s or other attack-boosting Ingredients. Eating one will temporarily increase Link's attack power. They also heal four Hearts, and they sell for 60 Rupees. * '''Tough Creamy Meat Soup''':{{Cite|{{Big|Tough Creamy Meat Soup}}
Grants a low-level defense boost.
This nutritious soup contains serious portions of lightly-braised meat and many vegetables.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Armoranth]]s or other defensive Ingredients. When consumed, these soups increase Link's defense for a time. They heal four Hearts and sell for 60 Rupees. * '''Sneaky Creamy Meat Soup''':{{Cite|{{Big|Sneaky Creamy Meat Soup}}
Grants a mid-level stealth boost.
This nutritious soup contains serious portions of lightly-braised meat and many vegetables.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Blue Nightshade]]s, [[Silent Princess]]es, or other sneaky Ingredients. When eaten, Link's [[Stealth]] will be boosted for a short while. They heal four of Link's Hearts, but they also can be sold for 60 Rupees. * '''Chilly Creamy Meat Soup''':{{Cite|{{Big|Chilly Creamy Meat Soup}}
Grants mid-level heat resistance.
This nutritious soup contains serious portions of lightly-braised meat and many vegetables.|Inventory|BotW}} Made using [[Cool Safflina]]s or other chilly Ingredients. Eating these soups grants Link one level of [[Heat Resistance]]. They heal four Hearts, and they sell for 60 Rupees. ==={{TotK|-}}=== {{Stub|TotK}} ==Other Appearances== ==={{AoC|-}}=== {{Noncanon|Start}} The [[Recipe]] for Creamy Meat Soup is obtained by completing the [[Scenario]] "[[Destroy the Yiga Clan!]]". It is made using one [[Hearty Radish]], one [[Raw Prime Meat]], one [[Fresh Milk]], and one [[Rock Salt]]. Preparing Creamy Meat Soup before a [[Challenge]] or [[Scenario]] will increase the [[Warrior]]s' [[Special Attack]] charge rate by seven percent. {{Noncanon|End}} ==Nomenclature== {{Nomenclature}} ==Gallery== File:AoC Creamy Meat Soup Icon.png|{{Game Label|{{AoC|-}}}}Creamy Meat Soup icon ==See Also== {{See Also| * Creamy Heart Soup * Creamy Seafood Soup * Food * Meal * Veggie Cream Soup }} {{Ref}} {{Categories |Food, Health Restoring Items, Meals, Soups |items= BotW, TotK, AoC }}
